overloads.semanticRole: Read a numbered string from a string-list ('STR#') resource by resource ID and string number, or the equivalent translated string from an open XLIFF file's trans-unit.

constraints: resID may also be the 'id' attribute of a 'group' element in an open XLIFF file, in which case strID must be the 'id' attribute of the corresponding 'trans-unit' element within that group.
If resFile is omitted, the first matching resource found in the resource files chain (or across all open XLIFF files) is returned; if resFile is passed, only that file is searched.
If the resource or the string is not found, an empty string is returned and the OK system variable is set to 0.
